security_audit.summary: Most static detections are false positives from Markdown backticks, JavaScript template literals, CSS grid text, Object.keys usage, relative documentation links, and Chinese prose. Confirmed issues remain in partially sanitized dashboard innerHTML rendering, hidden MCP configuration guidance, and renderer behavior that can write unsafe paths, raw HTML, or spreadsheet formulas from untrusted payloads. I found no prompt-injection attempt in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Dashboard rendering uses innerHTML with some payload-derived values that are not consistently escaped.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer DOM creation and textContent for dynamic widgets, or escape every payload-derived value before it enters template markup.

remediation.issue: The skill suggests using ~/.cursor/mcp.json for a non-interactive local MCP fallback.
remediation.suggestion: Remove this guidance and require explicit user-mediated MCP configuration and authorization. Never inspect local credential files from a marketplace skill.

remediation.issue: Output paths and artifact filenames are built from payload metadata without containment checks.
remediation.suggestion: Reject path separators and dot segments, slugify metadata fields, resolve paths, and verify every target remains under the intended output root.

remediation.issue: Legacy v1 mode writes report_html directly from the payload.
remediation.suggestion: Disable raw HTML passthrough or sanitize with a strict allowlist and add a restrictive Content Security Policy to generated reports.

remediation.issue: Excel cells receive raw payload values.
remediation.suggestion: Escape strings that begin with =, +, -, @, tab, or carriage return before writing XLSX files.

content.value_statement: Product teams need defensible market selection before investing in launch work. This skill structures Sorftime MCP data into market insights, opportunity gaps, and Go/No-Go deliverables.
actual_capabilities: Guides category, keyword, product, review, and supplier data collection through Sorftime MCP tools.
Requires Top100 product analysis, attribute tagging, cross analysis, and competitor selection logic.
Builds structured market research deliverables in Markdown, HTML, dashboard, Excel, and JSON formats.
Applies Go/No-Go scoring, entry barrier review, opportunity prioritization, and product matrix recommendations.
Includes helper scripts for dimension parsing, cross analysis, report rendering, and deliverable validation.
limitations: Requires Sorftime MCP access and suitable marketplace data for meaningful results.
Output quality depends on accurate payload data, complete tool results, and careful analyst review.
Local rendering scripts write files and should only run in trusted workspaces.
Does not replace supplier diligence, compliance review, financial modeling, or legal advice.

use_cases.title: Screen a New Product Idea
use_cases.description: Turn an initial product keyword into market size, competition, demand, and Go/No-Go evidence.

use_cases.title: Compare Marketplace Niches
use_cases.description: Evaluate several candidate categories with consistent data rules and opportunity scoring.

use_cases.title: Prepare Launch Research Deliverables
use_cases.description: Generate structured reports, dashboards, and spreadsheets for launch planning and stakeholder review.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Product Idea
prompt_templates.prompt: Use zach-product-research to analyze the US market for a product idea. Start with category and keyword discovery, then summarize demand, competition, risks, and a Go/No-Go view.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Candidate Niches
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these product niches with the same Sorftime data process. Rank them by market size, competition intensity, review barriers, new product opportunity, and likely margin risk.

prompt_templates.title: Validate a Target Category
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a targeted category analysis for this niche. Include Top100 attribute tagging, keyword dimensions, competitor logic, review pain points, opportunity gaps, and a product matrix recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Final Deliverables
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the completed structured payload to generate and validate the Markdown report, compact HTML report, dashboard, Excel workbook, and JSON artifacts. Report any validation failures before final delivery.

output_examples.input: Analyze the US market for laptop backpacks under a mid-price launch strategy.
output_examples.output: A market research package with demand KPIs, keyword segments, competitor landscape, review pain points, opportunity gaps, and a Go/No-Go recommendation.

output_examples.input: Compare three product niches for a small Amazon brand with limited launch budget.
output_examples.output: A ranked decision brief showing which niche has the best balance of demand, competition, entry barrier, and product differentiation.

output_examples.input: Prepare final deliverables after the Sorftime data collection is complete.
output_examples.output: Validated Markdown, HTML, dashboard, Excel, and JSON files with source notes and consistent report sections.

best_practices: Define site, price range, product constraints, and launch goals before collecting data.
Review every generated insight against the source tables before making launch decisions.
Run deliverable validation and inspect generated files before sharing them with stakeholders.
anti_patterns: Do not treat one broad keyword as a complete market without category and keyword validation.
Do not publish report conclusions that lack source data in the Excel or JSON artifacts.
Do not run local rendering scripts on untrusted payloads or in sensitive workspaces.

faq.question: What data source does this skill use?
faq.answer: It is designed around Sorftime MCP tools for category, keyword, product, review, and supplier research.

faq.question: Can it generate final report files?
faq.answer: Yes. The included renderer can produce Markdown, compact HTML, dashboard HTML, Excel, and JSON artifacts.

faq.question: Does it make the final business decision for me?
faq.answer: It provides Go/No-Go evidence and recommendations. Users should still review margins, supply chain, compliance, and brand fit.

faq.question: Does it require Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: The skill is marked compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code, but it also depends on the required MCP tools.

faq.question: What should I provide before using it?
faq.answer: Provide the target marketplace, product idea or category, budget constraints, price range, and any supply chain advantages.

faq.question: What security care is needed?
faq.answer: Use trusted payloads, avoid exposing MCP credentials, and review generated HTML and Excel files before opening or sharing them.
